l1_connect_account.title: Bring the unmanaged directories under the platform
l1_connect_account.why: The directory exists and people sign in through it, but the platform does not read it, so nothing in it is checked.
steps: Find the owner of each directory and the account that can grant read access.
Connect it with a read-only service account and the least privilege the platform documents.
Confirm the first sync lists accounts, groups and privileged roles.
l1_connect_account.success: Every directory in scope is connected and syncing.
